concepts.title: The Idea and Evolution of Democracy
concepts.definition: Democracy - rule by the people - has evolved over time from ancient assemblies and limited franchises to the modern universal adult franchise, shaping today's understanding that every adult citizen has an equal voice in choosing the government.
concepts.key_idea: Rule of the people has widened step by step: from few voices to universal franchise.
concepts.textbook_ref: iest106.txt opening sections (evolution of the idea of democracy)
question_patterns: how has the idea of democracy evolved over time
define democracy in your own words
what is universal adult franchise and why does it matter
why is democracy called government by discussion
what did early democracies lack that modern ones promise

solution_steps.explain: Democracy places political authority in the hands of the people.
Excluded groups fought for and won the right to vote over time.
Universal adult franchise and equal citizenship complete the idea.

concepts.title: Features of Democratic Government
concepts.definition: Democracy works through defining features: rulers are elected by the people, power is limited by a constitution, fundamental rights protect citizens, independent courts review actions, and governments remain accountable through discussion, debate and periodic elections.
concepts.key_idea: Election, constitution, rights and accountability - the four pillars that keep democracy standing.
concepts.textbook_ref: iest106.txt sections on features of democracy
question_patterns: state the main features of democracy
why are free and fair elections essential in a democracy
how does the constitution limit the power of rulers
what role do rights play in a democratic system
how can citizens hold a government accountable - give methods
is the given country democratic - test with the features

solution_steps.explain: Rulers must reach office through people's votes.
Constitution, rights and courts bind the rulers' hands.
Discussion, press and elections keep power answerable.

concepts.title: Democracy in India: Strengths and Challenges
concepts.definition: India adopted democracy with universal franchise in 1950, an extraordinary step for a diverse and newly free society; its strengths include regular elections and constitutional rights, while challenges such as inequality, social discrimination and money power test the system's health.
concepts.key_idea: Democracy is a journey, not a destination: Indian democracy keeps defending and deepening itself.
concepts.textbook_ref: iest106.txt sections on democracy in India, strengths and challenges
question_patterns: when did India adopt democratic government and what was remarkable about it
what are the strengths of Indian democracy
what challenges face democracy in India - discuss
how does inequality affect democratic participation
why is every election a test of democracy
suggest ways to deepen democracy in daily life

solution_steps.explain: Universal franchise from the start made India a bold experiment.
Inequality, discrimination and money power strain democratic fairness.
Voting, questioning and equal respect deepen the system.
